Kohlrabi vs Hevy.

Hevy is a polished, popular tracker — this is just an honest look at where the checkmarks land, including a few Hevy has that we don't.

Hevy's free tier caps routines and history depth; Pro removes the caps. If you love the social feed and the Watch app, Hevy is genuinely great at those — we don't try to match them.

Kohlrabi vs MacroFactor.

Strong's free tier is generous for logging but caps custom routines at 3; Pro is $4.99/month or $29.99/year. Its calculators and Watch app are genuinely useful — we leave the rest timer out on purpose to keep logging to fewer taps.

Kohlrabi vs Liftosaur.

Liftosaur is the most customizable tracker out there — an honest look at the tradeoffs, including what it has that we don't.

Kohlrabi vs Liftosaur feature comparison
FeatureKohlrabiLiftosaur
Free to useFree, foreverFree
Paid planNone — free foreverNone — open source
Native iPhone appWeb app (PWA)✓
Works offline✓✓
No account needed✓✓
Easy to use✓✕
Rest timerNo, on purpose✓
Plate calculator✕✓
Scriptable programs (Liftoscript)✕✓
Open source✕✓
Export your data✓ JSON✓

Liftosaur's Liftoscript lets you program progression logic as code — nothing else touches it for customizability, and it's open source. We trade that depth for a simpler setup: no scripting to learn before your first workout.

Bring your own file

Import a CSV

  1. Download the column template.
  2. Match your date, exercise, weight, reps, and optional RPE columns.
  3. Fix flagged rows in the preview, then import.
Bring it home

Import to Kohlrabi

  1. Get your export file from the app above — the app's own export or a CSV both work.
  2. In Kohlrabi, open Settings → Import and choose the file.
  3. Review the exercise matches and flagged rows in the preview, then import. Nothing joins your log until you confirm.

Import

Bring your training with you

Upload a workout-history CSV or MacroFactor spreadsheet to import saved workouts.

↑Tap to choose a fileHistory CSV, or a MacroFactor program (.xlsx)

History: columns date,workout_name,exercise,set,reps,weight_lb,rpe,tags,notes — dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Hevy exports and MacroFactor workout-history CSVs work as-is.

Saved workouts: a MacroFactor program/workout spreadsheet (.xlsx) — rep ranges become targets, RIR becomes RPE, warmup sets become Warmup tags.
